data.exact_reserve_text: A favourable run-off deviation (prior accident year increase) of GBP 2.5m (2015: run-off deviation of GBP 2.9m) was experienced during the year, wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2014 year of account and prior Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003.
data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding for 2016 was GBP 149.461m. The prior year development for 2016 was a strengthening of GBP 3.599m (2.41% of opening reserves), based on the gross claims development triangle for underwriting years 2014 and prior. This contrasts with a narrative statement on page 15 of a GBP 2.5m favourable run-off deviation for 2014 and prior years. Gross premiums written in 2016 were GBP 141.83m, with the largest segments being Property (48.29%) and Marine, aviation and transport (27.90%).

data.data_quality_notes: Discrepancy between narrative text (GBP 2.5m favourable deviation) and gross claims development triangle (+GBP 3.599m strengthening). Triangle figure used for prior_year_development_gbp_m as it is explicitly gross, while the narrative does not specify gross or net.
